attributes.name: Major Cure
attributes.powers: Reveal this card and choose a character at your location to shuffle 1d4+1 random cards from his discard pile into his deck. Shuffle 1 random card from your discard pile into your deck, then discard this card.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, succeed at a Divine 10 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
attributes.source: ROTR-3, ALCH-3, BARD-4, CLERIC-3, HUNTER-3, WITCH-3, ORACLE-3, WARPRIEST-4

corrections.corrected_text: On the spell Major Cure, the first power should end with "...into your deck, then discard this card."
corrections.issue: Major Cure tells me how I can recharge it instead of discarding it, but it doesn't actually tell me to discard it. Should it?
